lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: r7 fully closes the prior pre-queue validation and receipt-ordering gap, but the frozen artifact still keeps broader post-save deletion and retraction governance outside this release packet instead of proving the full downstream lifecycle after Save and check identity.
findings.evidence: artifact-r7.md lines 143-144 explicitly state that full post-save deletion/retraction across capture, resource, and wiki records remains a broader lifecycle-governance follow-up. The frozen code and tests prove the local pre-save chain instead: apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipCaptureView.swift:441-445 and 1063-1077 state that reviewed text and source metadata are saved separately from the original image, person binding, compiled wiki, and future actions; apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipCaptureStore.swift:86-98 and 185-209 show that downstream capture and identity flows begin only after the human taps Save and check identity; /tmp/talent-signal-action-button-c431452.xcresult contains 26 passing leaf tests for import rejection, review, keep/discard, receipt separation, and UI state, but no end-to-end post-save retraction test for derived reviewed-text, resource, or wiki records.
findings.user_impact: This does not introduce a silent import, silent external write, or wrong-assignment defect in the r7 Action Button capture path, but it leaves a narrower unanswered question about how a recruiter later retracts or supersedes reviewed evidence after intentionally promoting it beyond the local inbox.
findings.recommendation: Ship r7 for the scoped Action Button capture release, and schedule a separate frozen lifecycle audit that inventories every post-save reviewed-capture, identity-case, resource, and compiled-wiki representation with explicit delete, supersession, and audit behavior.
findings.verification: Freeze a follow-up artifact that starts immediately after Save and check identity, then proves which downstream records are created, how each can be deleted or superseded, and how later correction remains visible without erasing provenance.

strengths: The frozen r7 surface is intact: every source hash listed in artifact-r7.md recomputed to an exact SHA-256 match against product commit c43145222c7750bf5cfc705384e46ce694f325df before scoring.

The frozen result bundle /tmp/talent-signal-action-button-c431452.xcresult succeeded with 26 passing leaf tests and 0 failures, including RelationshipCaptureTests/testShortcutImporterRejectsBeforeQueueAndReceipt(), RelationshipCaptureTests/testShortcutScreenshotValidatorDecodesContentAndBoundsPayload(), RelationshipCaptureTests/testScreenshotShortcutReceiptRecordsObservedCaptureSeparately(), CandidateSignalUITests/testActionButtonAssignmentAndReceiptStatesRemainIndependent(), CandidateSignalUITests/testActionButtonSetupSeparatesObservedShortcutReceiptFromAssignment(), and CandidateSignalUITests/testPendingScreenshotReviewOffersKeepOrDiscardBeforeProcessing().

r7 resolves the prior medium safety finding with executable proof. apps/ios/Sources/App/CaptureAppIntents.swift:189-203 routes ImportConversationScreenshotIntent through ConversationScreenshotImporter.stage(), and apps/ios/Sources/App/CaptureAppIntents.swift:381-392 validate image content and bounds before PendingCaptureInbox.stage(...) and before TalentSignalSetupPreference.recordScreenshotShortcutReceived(defaults:) records any receipt timestamp.

The new negative-path coverage is specific and sufficient for this release. apps/ios/Tests/RelationshipCaptureTests.swift:7-46 and 48-123 prove corrupt bytes, payloads above 25 MiB, and over-80-megapixel input all fail before queue creation and before the screenshotShortcutReceivedAtKey changes from zero.

The local evidence store remains purpose-bounded and protected. apps/ios/Sources/Services/PendingCaptureInbox.swift:30-52, 65-96, 112-196, and 225-240 implement exact-payload deduplication, explicit per-item removal, complete file protection, backup exclusion, atomic writes, and rollback on partial persistence failure.

The user-visible state now preserves assignment and observed receipt as distinct facts across multiple surfaces. apps/ios/Sources/Features/AppSettingsView.swift:486-500 states that a screenshot received through the Shortcut confirms only the local handoff and does not prove current Action Button assignment; apps/ios/Sources/Features/AgentSourceSettingsView.swift:267-281, apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAgentStudioView.swift, and apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveSheets.swift show Local receipt separately from Assigned, and the r7 screenshots 5638E563-863E-488F-BC6E-5FAA0459495C.png and 23F307C1-00B3-494A-9A40-98FB2F106BAC.png visibly match that separation.

Release App Intents metadata in /tmp/talent-signal-action-button-release-r7-derived/Build/Products/Release-iphonesimulator/TalentSignal.app/Metadata.appintents/extract.actionsdata confirms ImportConversationScreenshotIntent with title Review screenshot, a required screenshot file parameter, background execution, openAppWhenRun false, and no advertised one-step App Shortcut tile for this required-image action.
missing_evidence: A dedicated post-save lifecycle artifact proving deletion or supersession behavior for reviewed capture records, identity cases, compiled wiki output, and any derived canonical state after Save and check identity.

A physical iPhone demonstration of Action Button assignment and press. artifact-r7.md correctly keeps hardware proof outside simulator evidence instead of claiming the simulator as physical-button validation.
open_questions: After reviewed text is explicitly saved, which exact user-visible surface owns later retraction if the conversation turns out to be unauthorized, stale, or identity-confused?

Will the planned post-save lifecycle audit preserve the same separation between observed source, recruiter correction, downstream derivation, and later supersession that r7 now preserves in the import and review stages?
